notes.title: V.1.1.0: Speedrun & Cutscenes Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338492/64ac83ba106fac746cd895041f506d6f7de4b38b.png[/img]

Hi Moldbreakers, it's been a while but we promised a speedrun mode, and here it is! Along with some beautifully made cutscenes to immerse you even further into the world of bread. This is it for us, thank you for playing and enjoying Moldbreaker! Till we meet again. ːsteamhappyː
[h2]Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The game now has an opening and an ending cutscene!
[*] Speedrun mode has been added, it can be found in the settings.
[/list]

Thumbnail art made by: Patterson
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338492/3c7bd78eebcb97b1115702c04749d8799ae12797.png[/img]

From all of us at Silly Business, thank you for making our dream come true!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338492/69c5ef3602ba775069ffe457b7a7b9b096a21851.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.0.8
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338492/52b623e5ffd516159aa3a6fb5a01c848e60961a4.png[/img]
[h2]Improvements & Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Addressed the black screen issue. (While we couldn’t replicate it on our own devices, we hope this resolves the problem. Please let us know if it works!)
[*] Enemies now resume roaming if they’re unable to reach you, rather than standing still.
[*] Bradley now has a chance to purr during his idle.
[*] Footstep sounds is not on loop anymore, so it actually resembles walking.
[*] The following options have been added to the settings screen:
[list]
[*] Added an FPS limit setting.
[*] Added a resolution setting.
[*] Added an option to completely disable the mouse lock to hopefully make it more accessible to software like MHOOK.
[/list]
[/list]
Some more changes are on the way, thank you for playing Moldbreaker!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338492/69c5ef3602ba775069ffe457b7a7b9b096a21851.png[/img]
- Silly Business

notes.title: Rise of the 2500 Loafs!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338492/602c22cd8fde50c9e97db642d51a9fbe4ec532ca.png[/img]

[h1]What a week![/h1]
We never could have imagined the incredible response that Moldbreaker has received! This past week has been an absolute whirlwind, and we’ve been blown away by all the love and creativity from you, our dear players.

[h2]We've seen it all..[/h2]
Over the last week we've been keeping an eye out on our socials to see the reception to our game, stuff like:

[list]
[*] Stunning fan-art!
[*] Amazing YouTube videos!
[*] Jaw-dropping speedrun submissions! (It has told us a lot about [i]our mishaps in design[/i]..)
[*] International articles featuring our game (this was a surreal moment for us!)
[/list]
To every single one of you who has played, shared, or talked about the game: thank you, truly, from the bottom of our hearts. It really means the world to us and we couldn't be happier!❤️

[h2]What's on the horizon?[/h2]
Over this next week we'll be pushing some smaller bug fixes, more frequent issues like the black screen bug and a new feature:
[h3]Speedrun Mode:[/h3]

- In-Game Timer: Track your runs down to the millisecond!
- Level-Specific Stats: See your times per level, aim for that personal best time!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338492/ab2a6bbb6bd1062e5c8997473520ec7f00147fe3.png[/img]

[h2]We couldn't have done it without you![/h2]
To give back to you, the people that have supported us. We want to highlight some of the incredible creations from our community. If you’d like to share your creations, share them in our Discord, tag us on social media or post them in the Steam Community Hub. We love to see it!

🌐 Discord: https://discord.gg/x3uMzYkTe9


[h3]Fan-Art:[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338492/fa5942e3e36a64128b2e9de53a51e1267ebfa53d.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338492/5eb55b6fc150498416e2647a9944c3323140d6f5.png[/img]

[h3]Speedruns:[/h3]
Our community has been hard at work beating our game in the fastest possible time, if you feel like entering the speedrun competition definitely check out our public Discord!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338492/8b284c0c755f819f9fc90176e894e5dd6bffefa7.png[/img]
[h3]YouTube Highlights:[/h3]
Just to shoutout a few, otherwise we'd have a wall of links:

[previewyoutube=lD03H-0i0Qg;full][/previewyoutube]
[previewyoutube=7RStI_BALBI;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]❤️ Thank You ❤️[/h2]
Thank you all so much for being part of this journey. Whether you’re breaking molds or breaking records, you’re making this adventure unforgettable for us. 💖

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338492/69c5ef3602ba775069ffe457b7a7b9b096a21851.png[/img]

- Silly Business

notes.title: v1.0.6
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45338492/bd8ede45906a0aa3c86ec18e784ca56db4c2dca8.png[/img]
[h2]Improvements & Changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] The Fade Transition when entering a level now works as intended.
[*] The UI has been redesigned to better fit frame boundaries, with updated fonts for improved readability.
[*] The Settings menu is now accessible directly from the in-game Pause Menu.
[*] Muffins now bounce higher, making it easier to access certain areas.
[*] The second "Yeast of Power" now displays the correct button prompts.
[*] Bradley’s Idle Animation has been fixed to loop.
[*] The Ranged Enemy now uses the correct texture for its body.
[*] Level 1 Calories now display correctly in the door pop-up.
[*] The Quit button in the Pause Menu has been updated:
[list]
[*] While in a level, it returns players to the Hub.
[*] While in the Hub, it takes players back to the Main Menu.
[/list]
[/list]
[h2]Level Adjustments:[/h2]
[h3]Level 1[/h3]
[list]
[*] The large moving platform now pauses briefly at its endpoint, giving players more time to jump off.
[*] A platform in the Breadcano section has been adjusted to prevent it from moving through an invisible wall.
[/list]
